passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: Carla Mendes <cmendes@sunrisebakery.example>
From: Raymond Ito <rito@itovance.example>
Date: October 14
Subject: Documents needed for your lease review

Dear Ms. Mendes,

Thank you for choosing Ito & Vance to review the lease for your new bakery location on Harlow Street. Attorney Vance has begun reading the agreement and has noted several clauses she would like to discuss with you, especially those on rent increases and early termination.

To complete our review, we still need three items: a copy of your business license, the floor plan of the premises, and the landlord's proof of insurance. You may send them as attachments to this e-mail or drop them off at our office, which is open weekdays from 8:30 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.

Because the landlord has asked for a signed lease by October 28, we would like to receive the documents by Friday, October 18. Attorney Vance has openings for a meeting on October 21 or 22.

Sincerely,
Raymond Ito
Paralegal, Ito & Vance LLP

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
options: To confirm payment of legal fees
To announce a change in office hours
To request documents needed for a legal review
To invite Ms. Mendes to sign a lease
questions.explain: Đoạn 2 nêu "we still need three items" (giấy phép kinh doanh, sơ đồ mặt bằng, bảo hiểm của chủ nhà) để hoàn tất việc xem xét hợp đồng thuê, nên mục đích là yêu cầu giấy tờ.

questions.q: By what date does the landlord want the lease to be signed?
questions.explain: Email nói "the landlord has asked for a signed lease by October 28". Các ngày 18 (hạn nộp giấy tờ), 21 và 22 (ngày có thể họp) là bẫy.

passages.text:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS
Westbrook Commerce Center
June 3

Elevator Modernization Project

Beginning Monday, June 17, Elevators 3 and 4 in the north tower will be closed for modernization work by Kestrel Lift Services. The project is expected to last six weeks. Elevators 1 and 2 will remain in service, but tenants should expect longer waits during the morning and lunch hours.

Building Management

questions.q: What are tenants on the lower floors encouraged to do?
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: "Tenants on floors 2 through 5 are encouraged to use the stairwells" - stairwells chính là cầu thang bộ.

questions.q: According to the notice, what must tenants do to have large items delivered?
options: Notify the front desk two days ahead
questions.explain: "at least 48 hours in advance" = trước ít nhất hai ngày, và phải báo cho front desk. Ms. Lamar chỉ hỗ trợ người gặp khó khăn về di chuyển.

passages.title: News article
passages.text:
Harborline Freight Opens Inland Distribution Hub
By staff reporter | August 9

FERNDALE - Harborline Freight, a regional logistics provider, opened a 40,000-square-meter distribution hub in Ferndale on Thursday, a move the company says will cut delivery times to inland customers by up to two days. The facility, located near the junction of Highway 12 and the rail line, can handle 3,000 pallets per day and was built to receive shipments by both truck and train.

"Until now, goods arriving at our port terminal had to be trucked 200 kilometers before being sorted," said operations director Priya Raman. "Here, we can sort and dispatch goods the same day they arrive by rail."

The hub has created 220 jobs, and the company plans to hire 80 more by year-end, mostly warehouse operators and drivers. Harborline also said that the building's solar roof will supply about 40 percent of its electricity.

Mayor Tom Aldous, who attended the opening ceremony, praised the project for "bringing steady employment to our community." Analysts, however, noted that the company must still prove its new system can cope with the holiday-season rush.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: The opening of a new shipping facility
The retirement of a company executive
questions.explain: Bài báo mở đầu bằng việc Harborline "opened a 40,000-square-meter distribution hub", rồi mô tả công suất, việc làm, năng lượng - nội dung chính là khai trương trung tâm phân phối.

questions.q: According to Ms. Raman, what advantage does the new hub offer?
options: It reduces the number of employees needed
It lowers the cost of electricity
It is closer to the port terminal
It is no longer necessary to truck goods to another site first
questions.explain: Bà Raman nói trước đây hàng phải chở 200 km mới được phân loại, còn nay "sort and dispatch ... the same day they arrive by rail". Phương án đúng diễn đạt lại ý đó.

questions.q: The word "handle" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "can handle 3,000 pallets per day" nghĩa là có thể xử lý/tiếp nhận 3.000 pallet mỗi ngày, gần nghĩa nhất với "process".

passages.title: Online chat discussion
passages.text:
Hana Ruiz [9:41 A.M.]: Good morning, both. Did the invoice-export fix go out in last night's release?

Marcus Bell [9:43 A.M.]: It was supposed to, but QA found a rounding error in the tax column, so I pulled it from the release.

Joel Park [9:44 A.M.]: Right. I can fix that today, but I'll need the sample file from the Bridgeway account.

Hana Ruiz [9:46 A.M.]: I'll ask their accountant. They've been waiting since the 5th, and I told them to expect it by Friday.

Marcus Bell [9:47 A.M.]: Then let's aim for a patch tomorrow at noon. Joel, can you code the fix while I run the tests?

Joel Park [9:49 A.M.]: Sure thing. Hana, please make sure the file really has several tax rates in it. The last one didn't.

Hana Ruiz [9:50 A.M.]: Will do. I'll also tell Bridgeway to hold off on their quarterly filing until the patch is installed.

Marcus Bell [9:52 A.M.]: Good idea.

questions.q: Why was the invoice-export fix left out of the release?
options: The customer asked for a delay
A problem was found during testing
questions.explain: Marcus nói "QA found a rounding error in the tax column, so I pulled it from the release" - lỗi được phát hiện khi kiểm thử nên bản sửa bị rút khỏi bản phát hành.

questions.q: What will Ms. Ruiz most likely do next?
questions.explain: Hana nói "I'll ask their accountant" để lấy file mẫu cho Joel. Viết mã là việc của Joel, chạy kiểm thử là của Marcus.

questions.q: At 9:49 A.M., what does Mr. Park mean when he writes, "Sure thing"?
options: He is certain the file is correct
He has already finished the work
He wants to change the deadline
He agrees to write the fix
questions.explain: Marcus hỏi "Joel, can you code the fix...?" và Joel đáp "Sure thing" - tức là đồng ý nhận việc viết bản sửa.

passages.title: Customer review
passages.text:
Great equipment, crowded evenings (4 out of 5 stars)
Posted by Dana K. | March 22 | Pulse Athletic Club

I joined Pulse Athletic Club six months ago after my previous gym closed, and overall I am pleased. The equipment is modern and well maintained, and staff members wipe down the machines every hour. The free-weights area is larger than at most clubs I have tried, and the Tuesday-morning spin class led by Coach Tomas is worth the trip alone.

However, between 5:30 and 7:30 P.M. the cardio floor gets so busy that you may wait twenty minutes for a treadmill. The club told me it plans to add 15 machines after a renovation in June, which I hope will solve the problem. I also wish the locker rooms had more showers; there are only four.

Response from management (March 24): Thank you for your feedback, Dana. We are sorry about the evening waits. As a gesture of appreciation, we have added a free guest pass to your account. You may also find the cardio floor much quieter after 8:00 P.M.

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a strength of Pulse Athletic Club?
questions.explain: Dana khen thiết bị hiện đại, khu tạ tự do rộng và lớp spin, nhưng không hề nhắc đến giá hội viên thấp.

questions.q: What does the club plan to do in June?
questions.explain: "it plans to add 15 machines after a renovation in June" - thêm máy tập sau khi cải tạo. Dana chỉ mong có thêm vòi sen, không nói là sẽ xây.

questions.q: What did the management give Dana?
options: A free pass for a visitor
questions.explain: Phần phản hồi: "we have added a free guest pass to your account" - vé miễn phí cho khách đi cùng.

questions.q: The word "pleased" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "overall I am pleased" nghĩa là nhìn chung tôi hài lòng, tương đương "satisfied".

passages.title: Maintenance request form
passages.text:
OAKMONT RESIDENCES - MAINTENANCE REQUEST

Tenant: Lucia Ferreira          Unit: 4C
Date submitted: April 9         Phone: 555-0188 (best after 5:00 P.M.)

Description of problem:
Water is leaking from the kitchen ceiling. A brown stain about one meter wide has appeared since Sunday, and it drips whenever the upstairs tenant uses the shower.

Priority:  [ ] Routine   [ ] Urgent   [X] Emergency
Permission to enter if tenant is not at home:  [X] Yes   [ ] No

--- FOR OFFICE USE ONLY ---
Received by: Bruno Hale, April 9, 8:15 A.M.
Assigned to: Delmar Pipe Services (plumber)
Scheduled visit: April 10, 9:00 A.M. to 12:00 noon
Notes: Contact tenant in Unit 5C. Ceiling repair to be done by in-house painter after the leak is fixed; estimated 3 working days.

questions.q: Where is the water most likely coming from?
options: A bathroom in the apartment above
questions.explain: Mẫu ghi nước nhỏ giọt "whenever the upstairs tenant uses the shower", và ghi chú nhắc liên hệ Unit 5C - căn ngay phía trên 4C.

questions.q: What is indicated about Ms. Ferreira?
options: She works at Delmar Pipe Services.
She allows staff to enter her unit in her absence.
She prefers to be called in the morning.
She has rented the unit for six months.
questions.explain: Ô "Permission to enter if tenant is not at home" được đánh dấu Yes. Giờ gọi tốt nhất là sau 5 giờ chiều, không phải buổi sáng.

questions.q: Who will fix the ceiling once the leak has been stopped?
options: A plumber from Delmar Pipe Services
A painter who works for the building
questions.explain: Ghi chú: "Ceiling repair to be done by in-house painter after the leak is fixed" - thợ sơn của chính tòa nhà. Thợ ống nước chỉ sửa chỗ rò.

questions.q: What will happen on April 10?
options: A plumber will visit the unit in the morning.
The tenant in 5C will move out.
Mr. Hale will call Ms. Ferreira.
questions.explain: "Scheduled visit: April 10, 9:00 A.M. to 12:00 noon" của Delmar Pipe Services (thợ ống nước) - tức sáng ngày 10/4 thợ sẽ đến.

questions.q: Why did Ms. Petrov write to Seabridge?
options: To ask about a late delivery and order another one
To apply for a job as a driver
questions.explain: Bà Petrov báo lô hàng chậu bị trễ ("still shows the shipment at the Redford sorting center") và nhờ gửi thêm lô hạt giống, nên mục đích là hỏi về hàng trễ và đặt thêm một lô.

questions.q: How much did Hartwell Garden Supply most likely pay to ship the planters?
questions.explain: "your cheapest service" là Standard Ground ($0.80/kg); 120 kg x $0.80 = $96,00. $168 là giá Express Ground, $372 là Air Priority.

questions.q: Which service should Ms. Petrov choose for the seed packets?
questions.explain: Hạt giống nặng 20 kg (dưới 25 kg) và cần đến nơi "tomorrow morning". Chỉ Air Priority giao trong ngày làm việc kế tiếp; Express mất 2-3 ngày.

questions.q: What is suggested about the pickup of the seed packets?
options: It can be done today if the order is confirmed before 2:00 P.M.
It will cost $15 more than usual.
It is possible only on weekends.
questions.explain: Email gửi lúc 11:30 A.M.; trang web ghi "Orders confirmed before 2:00 P.M. are collected the same day". Phí $15 chỉ áp dụng cho đơn dưới $200 và không nói là cao hơn bình thường.

questions.q: The word "due" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "it was due on May 13" nghĩa là lô hàng được dự kiến/lên lịch đến vào ngày 13/5, gần nghĩa với "scheduled" (không phải "owed" - nợ).

They are held only on weekends.
They are for existing clients only.
questions.explain: Quảng cáo ghi "Your first 30-minute consultation is free" - buổi tư vấn đầu tiên miễn phí và kéo dài 30 phút.

questions.q: How much will Mr. Adeyemi most likely pay for the services he requested?
questions.explain: Thành lập công ty $850 + xem xét hợp đồng 14 trang = $300 + 4 x $20 = $380; tổng $1,230. Được giảm 10% nhờ giới thiệu từ Moran Accounting, còn $1,107. Gói trọn $1,200 gồm cả dịch vụ ông không cần.

questions.q: Which service did Mr. Adeyemi decline?
questions.explain: Ông viết "I already hold a trademark ... so I do not need a search" - nên không yêu cầu tra cứu nhãn hiệu.

questions.q: What will Mr. Adeyemi most likely do on December 3?
options: Meet with Ms. Moran to plan his taxes
Sign a lease with Whitcombe & Sato
questions.explain: Email của bà Moran: "When we meet on December 3 for tax planning, please bring receipts..." - ông sẽ gặp bà để lập kế hoạch thuế.

passages.title: Memo
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All tenants, Parkview Office Building
From: Rosa Delgado, Facilities Manager
Date: September 18
Subject: Roof repair

As many of you know, the roof has leaked in several places during recent storms. After receiving three bids from qualified contractors, the building's owner has selected Summit Roofing to replace the roof membrane. Work is scheduled to begin on Monday, October 7.

During the project, Section C of the parking lot will be closed so that equipment can be delivered. Tenants who normally park there may use the garage on Elm Street at no charge; please show your building ID to the attendant. Some noise should be expected on weekdays from 7:30 A.M. to 4:00 P.M.

Thank you for your understanding.

passages.title: Estimate
passages.text:
SUMMIT ROOFING - ESTIMATE #3318
Project: Parkview Office Building

Removal of old roof membrane ................. $6,400
Installation of new roof membrane ........... $14,200
Replacement of roof drains ................... $1,800
Total ....................................... $22,400

Optional: Resealing of skylights ............... $950

Terms: A deposit of 30% of the final price is due at signing. Work takes approximately 10 working days, weather permitting. The membrane carries a 10-year warranty; labor is guaranteed for 2 years. Prices include all materials and the disposal of old roofing. This estimate is valid for 60 days from the date of issue, and building permits are the responsibility of the owner.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: All tenants, Parkview Office Building
From: Rosa Delgado
Date: October 2
Subject: Update on roof repair

Dear tenants,

Because heavy rain is forecast for next week, Summit Roofing has asked to postpone the start of work by one week. The new start date is Monday, October 14. The owner has also approved the optional skylight resealing, since the roof will already be open. Our deposit payment will be based on the revised total.

The parking arrangements described in my earlier memo will not change.

Rosa Delgado

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To ask tenants to vote on a contractor
To inform tenants about upcoming work on the building
To request bids from roofing companies
questions.explain: Memo thông báo cho người thuê rằng Summit Roofing sẽ thay mái nhà từ 7/10 và nêu ảnh hưởng (bãi đỗ xe, tiếng ồn). Việc chọn nhà thầu đã xong, không phải lấy ý kiến.

questions.q: The word "bids" in paragraph 1 of the memo is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "three bids from qualified contractors" là ba bản chào giá/đề xuất của các nhà thầu, gần nghĩa nhất với "offers".

questions.q: What change is announced in the e-mail?
options: The parking lot will stay open.
The work will be done at night.
The project will begin a week later than planned.
questions.explain: Email nói Summit đề nghị "postpone the start of work by one week" - từ 7/10 lùi sang 14/10 vì dự báo mưa to.

questions.q: How much will the deposit most likely be?
questions.explain: Chủ nhà đã duyệt thêm việc trám khe giếng trời nên tổng mới là $22,400 + $950 = $23,350; cọc 30% = $7,005. $6,720 là 30% của giá chưa gồm phần tùy chọn.

questions.q: When is the work expected to be finished if there are no weather delays?
questions.explain: Bắt đầu thứ Hai 14/10 và cần khoảng 10 ngày làm việc (theo báo giá), nên xong vào thứ Sáu 25/10.

passages.title: Web page
passages.text:
TASKBRIDGE 5.0 IS HERE

What is new
- Timeline view: see every task and deadline on one visual calendar
- Offline mode: keep working on your phone without a connection; changes sync when you reconnect
- Integration with CalendarSync

Pricing: $8 per user per month when billed annually, or $10 per user per month when billed monthly. Existing customers upgrade free of charge.

Special offer: Customers who upgrade to version 5.0 by November 30 receive three months of Priority Support at no cost.

System requirements for the desktop app: Windows 10 or later; macOS 12 or later. The web version works with any current browser.

passages.title: Customer review
passages.text:
Timeline view is a winner, but offline mode needs work (3 out of 5 stars)
Posted by Kaito Ishii | November 12

I manage a team of 14 at a packaging company, and we upgraded to version 5.0 last week. The timeline view is excellent; it has saved me at least two hours of planning every Monday. The mobile app is fast, too.

Unfortunately, offline mode lost several of my edits when I reconnected after a flight. Also, most of our office computers still run an older version of macOS, so we cannot install the desktop app and have to use the browser. It works, but I would prefer a proper app.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: Kaito Ishii
From: Lucia Ferrer, TaskBridge Customer Care
Date: November 14
Subject: Your recent review

Dear Mr. Ishii,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are sorry that you lost your work. The synchronization problem you describe is known to our engineers, and a correction will be included in version 5.0.2, which we will release on November 20. Until then, please avoid editing the same task on two devices while offline.

Regarding the desktop app, support for older systems is not planned, but the web version contains every feature. As an apology, we have credited your account with one free month.

Sincerely,
Lucia Ferrer

questions.q: What problem did Mr. Ishii experience?
options: Some changes disappeared after he went back online.
The mobile app was too slow.
He could not log in to the web version.
The timeline view displayed the wrong dates.
questions.explain: Trong bài đánh giá: "offline mode lost several of my edits when I reconnected" - một số chỉnh sửa bị mất khi kết nối lại. Ông khen ứng dụng di động nhanh.

questions.q: What is suggested about the computers in Mr. Ishii's office?
options: They cannot run the desktop app.
They cannot connect to the Internet.
questions.explain: Ông viết máy văn phòng chạy macOS cũ nên không cài được app; trang web yêu cầu macOS 12 trở lên, vậy máy của ông không đáp ứng yêu cầu hệ thống.

questions.q: When will the problem be corrected?
questions.explain: Email của bà Ferrer: "version 5.0.2, which we will release on November 20". Ngày 14/11 là ngày viết email, 30/11 là hạn ưu đãi.

questions.q: What does Mr. Ishii like most about TaskBridge 5.0?
options: A feature that shows tasks visually
questions.explain: Ông nói "The timeline view is excellent; it has saved me at least two hours of planning" - tính năng hiển thị công việc dạng lịch trực quan.

questions.q: What benefit has Mr. Ishii most likely already received?
questions.explain: Ông nâng cấp lên 5.0 "last week" (trước 30/11), nên đủ điều kiện nhận 3 tháng Priority Support miễn phí theo trang web. Tháng miễn phí trong email là tín dụng xin lỗi, không phải hoàn tiền.
